target: chos ma yin pa la zhen pa dang / chos ma yin pa la 'dod cing chags pa dang log pa dang chos spyod pa dang / dam pa'i chos la yid mi ches pa dang / tshe'i tshad rab tu thung ba dang / nyes pa byed pa dag yod na rgyal pos chad pas gcod pa dang / rgyal po dag yul dang srid yod bzhin du chog cing ngoms mi shes te/
